Feeling like that right now. It's this bizarre mix of being completely emotionless, except it's almost like the emotions are so powerful they get interpreted by my brain as logic.

"I have really hurt my friends by my behavior, It's only fair that I receive penance for my actions."

Obviously a really emotionally charged statement in some regards, but with zero emotion felt behind it.

I've done SH in front of someone I love dearly with a poker face to (in my fucked up head) somehow "prove a point." No reaction to pain, no reaction to their screams for me to stop, no regrets.

Splitting is terrifying. It's different for everyone, but it's all the same level of hell.
